reuse.why: Calls the new guard from every link function, but linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions are copies of the Pluggy.ai versions, and the takeover unlink re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: About 70 lines of linkPluggyAiAccount are cloned for Fintegra, the download function is cloned, and the unlink column reset is copied from unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts while link.ts holds link helpers, and a function named assert* now also mutates other accounts (the takeover unlink).

scope.why: Stays within linking and the new provider; small client edits are only needed for the provider record typing.

maintainability.why: assertBankAccountNotLinked has grown into a closed-check plus duplicate-check plus side-effecting takeover behind a boolean, while each provider's link body remains a separate copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link functions call assertBankAccountNotLinked; the unlink reset does not reuse unlinkAccount, but that function also performs provider-side cleanup the spec forbids here.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (linkFintegraAccount from linkPluggyAiAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions, the unlink column reset) are verbatim, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts gained the replaceExistingLink flag, a closed-account branch and a replace-and-unlink branch on top of its duplicate-link check.
